acceptanceCriteria: A per-example coverage input format is specified (or an existing one cited) with numbered requirements
An example whose target lines have zero coverage in its own run is reported; a covered example is not; synthetic fixtures cover both
body: GitHub #1124 optional ask, not delivered by PR #1125: it needs per-example coverage input that Corvint does not ingest yet. Example: a guard `if amount.negative?` that the default factory data never reaches, while the example name claims to test that branch. Expected: given per-example coverage, an example whose claimed target lines have zero hits is reported. Actual: no per-example coverage input exists.
title: test-validity: flag expectations whose target lines had zero coverage in that example's run (#1124 optional ask)
